summary: Mayberne was one of four 1938 radio lookouts near Edson; the provincial dataset dates the present 18 m steel tower to 2011 and lists it active.

facts.design: Steel tower, 18 m (59 ft) high, per the provincial lookout dataset

events.note: Radio lookout station placed in operation northwest of Edson; each unit's cabin gave the lookout man living quarters
New ladder built on the tower, legs creosoted, radio poles and stubs replaced
Cabin shingled outside; inside finished and painted
Year the present steel tower was built, per the provincial dataset

notes_for_editor: The 1938 to 1949 history comes from a hobby site that transcribes a 1938 Calgary Herald report and Alberta annual reports; I did not check those originals. The 2011 date and 18 m height are from the provincial dataset and match our record, but the sources do not say whether the 2011 tower stands where the 1938 station did, so the story does not claim it. No fire history, no current staffing and no visitor rule was found. The brief's access 'closed' is not backed by a source I read, so no access fact is recorded. The 1946 annual report on the same site spells the road 'Mayburn', which is a spelling variant only.
